scope: Gate 4 schema assumptions used by policy authority and restart/concurrency paths
verificationMode: Migration/source trace now; pg_catalog proof must be captured from the same disposable PG17 live-shape clone used by Gate 2

requiredShape: semantic namespace/key/platform identity resolves at most one authoritative row
payload is jsonb and validated as an object by the consumer
lifecycle_key/status are compatible with lifecycle_state_definitions
disabled or non-dispatchable state cannot satisfy an active lookup
assumptions.cardinality: zero => typed unavailable/fail closed; one valid active row => proceed; duplicate/ambiguous => typed failure
assumptions.catalogProbe: pg_catalog columns, constraints, indexes and foreign keys for runtime_semantic_entries plus lifecycle_state_definitions

requiredShape: resource table and state/lifecycle columns are explicit binding data
binding identity is unique for a resource
initial/dispatchable/terminal/retryable flags come from lifecycle_state_definitions
configured state columns have validated foreign-key-compatible values
assumptions.cardinality: missing/ambiguous binding => fail closed; exactly one enabled compatible binding => proceed
assumptions.catalogProbe: binding columns and uniqueness; lifecycle state partial unique initial index; transition PK/FK/check constraints

requiredShape: policy is jsonb object
resource/binding identity is unique
consumer never substitutes TypeScript semantic defaults for missing policy
assumptions.cardinality: zero => unavailable/fail closed; one valid row => proceed; malformed/duplicate => typed failure
assumptions.catalogProbe: columns, jsonb type/check constraints, unique identity and foreign keys

requiredShape: resource_name is authoritative identity
policy is jsonb object
updated_at supports observable reload/invalidation
assumptions.cardinality: zero => unavailable/fail closed; one valid row => proceed; malformed/duplicate => typed failure
assumptions.catalogProbe: primary/unique identity, jsonb constraint/default, nullability and timestamp default

requiredShape: request_key and payload hash support replay/conflict discrimination
lease owner/generation/expiry support stale-owner rejection
status/lifecycle state is DB authoritative
assumptions.cardinality: request identity resolves zero or one durable job; replay returns same identity; conflicting payload is rejected
assumptions.catalogProbe: request identity unique index, lease generation/check/defaults, lifecycle FK/columns and status indexes

requiredShape: request_key format and uniqueness support idempotency
claim owner/expiry and dispatcher expiry support recovery
dispatch_attempts is nonnegative
resource runtime policy is DB authoritative
assumptions.cardinality: request identity resolves zero or one job; concurrent claims update exactly one owner
assumptions.catalogProbe: request/claim indexes, checks, defaults, event FK and dispatcher expiry index

requiredShape: external/root and operation identities are unique
owner/dispatch generations are nonnegative and used as CAS fences
execution identity is required in execution states
recovery and FIFO indexes match claim predicates
assumptions.cardinality: one root/job per idempotency identity; one winner per claim generation; stale result cannot terminalize
assumptions.catalogProbe: unique and partial indexes, generation checks/defaults, execution-id state check, event foreign keys

requiredShape: idempotency key is unique where present
request/execution keys satisfy canonical format checks
lifecycle/status values are DB authoritative
safety admission rows are durable across restart
assumptions.cardinality: same request returns same run/binding; conflicting canonical payload is rejected
assumptions.catalogProbe: idempotency unique index and predicate, lifecycle columns/FKs, binding PK/checks and admission window index

requiredShape: incident status/severity and ownership are durable
event_key is unique for idempotent event append
audit run/findings preserve one coherent snapshot identity
open backlog readback is derived from DB lifecycle state
assumptions.cardinality: incident identity resolves one row; duplicate event key is idempotent; repeated daily audit is stable for the same snapshot
assumptions.catalogProbe: status/severity checks, event-key unique index, audit finding FK/index, reconciliation columns/defaults

requiredShape: candidate and validation confidence/status checks are enforced
runtime enablement is structural and DB authoritative
snapshot replay identity and coverage uniqueness support coalescing
assumptions.cardinality: one active runtime authority per scope; duplicate recovery context coalesces; stale owner cannot promote
assumptions.catalogProbe: status/confidence checks, active/runtime columns, replay and coverage unique indexes, foreign keys

requiredCatalogCapture.acceptance: Every relation above must have a captured PG17 row for columns, defaults, nullability, PK/FK/unique/check constraints and relevant index predicates; no UNKNOWN or mismatch is accepted.
